reviewed_by: Claude review of the harness command-runtime execution-mode accessor
reason: On origin/main, test_chat_rolls_over_to_current_command_runtime_without_mutating_frozen_session failed both parametrizations with AttributeError: 'Commands' object has no attribute 'manager'. 08be66f ('fix: preserve native tools in host harness mode') added HarnessRuntimeService._project_execution_mode, which reached through automation_tool_platform.manager.project_policy(...).execution_mode. That widened the implicit platform protocol the harness runtime depends on from chat_components/store to a nested runtime manager, and the pre-existing rollover stub from #228 was never updated. AutomationToolPlatform now exposes project_execution_mode(engagement_id) and the harness runtime calls that facade instead of reaching two levels in; chat_components uses the same accessor so the policy lookup is written once. Selected: tests/v3/test_harnesses.py (the rollover regression plus every host-mode and unprepared-runtime path through _project_execution_mode); tests/v3/test_ssh_environments.py and tests/v3/test_tool_catalog.py, which drive chat_components on a real AutomationToolPlatform; and tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py, which covers the AutomationRuntimeManager.project_policy lookup the new accessor wraps.
exclusions: No full suites. Backend-only change with no UI, schema, or API surface, so no frontend, native, or Playwright entries. tests/v3/test_harness_adapters.py is excluded: test_claude_native_capabilities_exclude_project_files_and_shell fails identically on pristine main (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash present in the native tool set). That is a separate pre-existing main regression with its own fix in flight, untouched by this change; the rest of that file covers adapter option construction, which this change does not reach. tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py was excluded on an earlier revision of this branch for a pre-existing KeyError: 'untrusted_data' failure; #367 fixed that, so the file is now selected.
